test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Transform the following sentence into active voice.

This law which was passed in the parliament last year should have been reviewed properly by the members of the committee.

options.text: The parliament should have reviewed the law properly, which the members of the committee passed last year.
The members of the committee should have reviewed the law properly, which the parliament passed last year.
The law should have reviewed the members of the committee properly which the parliament passed last year.
The members of the committee should have reviewed the law properly, which was passed in the parliament last year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passive voice sentence, the action is being performed on the subject by the members of the committee.
 
• To convert to active voice, make the members of the committee the subject performing the action.
 
• The phrase "should have been reviewed properly" changes to "should have reviewed the law properly" to align with active voice structure.
 
• The time reference "last year" remains unchanged, and the phrase "which was passed in the parliament" is retained to provide context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The members of the committee should have reviewed the law properly, which the parliament passed last year."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The parliament should have reviewed the law properly, which the members of the committee passed last year." – Incorrect subject performing the action.
 
• **Option 3: **"The law should have reviewed the members of the committee properly which the parliament passed last year." – Incorrect structure; the law cannot perform the action.
 
• **Option 4: **"The members of the committee should have reviewed the law properly, which was passed in the parliament last year." – Incorrect use of passive phrase "was passed" without aligning it to active voice.
